label: Bible Study
prompt: But I say unto you, Love your _____, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verse: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
note: The hardest line in the Sermon on the Mount — love aimed at the people least likely to return it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wait on the LORD: be of good _____, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
verse: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
note: Wait, take courage, wait again — David bookends the advice, because waiting is the hard part.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now the serpent was more _____ than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
verse: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
note: The KJV spells it 'subtil' — and the serpent opens Eden's first conversation by questioning what God really said.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But they shall sit every man under his _____ and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
verse: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
note: Micah's peace picture — every family under its own vine and fig tree; George Washington loved quoting it in his letters.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ the time, because the days are evil.
verse: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
note: 'Redeeming the time' — buying up every opportunity, because the days are evil. Time management, Pauline edition.
